title: Repeated CONNECT failures from 10.14.7.31 to the same uncategorized host
description: The proxy logged repeated CONNECT attempts from the alerting host to cdn-telemetry-sync.net, each terminated on DNS failure with zero bytes transferred. The same host also fetched a raw paste from an uncategorized developer-tools domain with a non-browser user agent, once, mid-window.

log_pointers.why: first half of the window, including the paste fetch with a python-requests user agent
second half of the window; note the security-feed request from the SIEM collector
